prompts.title: A / COMPACT COMBUSTION
prompts.prompt:
Create an original professional WEAPON EFFECTS concept sheet for a smooth stylized 3D irreverent top-down city game. Nighttime ordinary city architecture, chunky readable smooth forms, navy/petrol asphalt, restrained cyan and magenta city lights. No real brands, no typography within the world. This is visual concept art, not a rendered engine capture.
LAYOUT: wide landscape sheet, clear title, generous spacing. Upper two thirds: four horizontal rows labelled MUZZLE, HIT, ROCKET TRAIL, EXPLOSION; exactly four chronologically ordered panels per row, arrows indicating time. Each panel shows the same effect progressing, not different designs. Show all sequence panels from true vertical overhead with north up, never side-on, never isometric. Pale ivory labels on dark navy borders. Label stages IGNITE, PEAK, BREAK, CLEAR. Clear final frames have barely any residual wisps. Muzzle and trail local forward points toward top of page; trail is behind rocket toward bottom. Weapon and rocket are neutral small charcoal silhouettes only, provisional scale reference rather than weapon concepts. Hit is surface impact on asphalt, not gore. Give actors and road lane marks clear gaps through smoke.
LOWER THIRD: a wide gameplay-context inset labelled TOP-DOWN CAMERA STUDY / CONCEPT ONLY. It is an illustrative view using vertically downward perspective, 47 metre camera height, 42 degree FOV, north up, aspect 1280:800. Show an ordinary dark street corner with rooftops only, small 1.8 metre stylized pedestrians and 4 metre cars for scale; one muzzle flash, one hit, one rocket with short trail, one explosion visible in different parts of frame. Ground coverage about 58 by 36 metres. No tilted facades, no horizon. Effects must read at this distant framing, with compact dense cores and separated outer pieces, never a giant sheet of opaque fog. Larger upper panels are enlargement studies; inset keeps honest small game-scale appearance.
Each explosion sequence is a compact core, separated outward fire lobes and a few sparks, broken slate smoke then clear. No persistent damage decal, no collision depiction, no UI health bars, no damage-radius disk. Smooth stylized 3D shading; chunky silhouettes and restrained bloom, not photoreal war imagery.
DIRECTION: A / COMPACT COMBUSTION
Warm physical cartoon combustion. Muzzle: tiny ivory hot tapered petal with amber rim, compact directional teardrop, two short sparks, immediate clear. Hit: short amber wedge sparks and a small slate puff with visible gaps, no large energy ring. Trail: spaced small ivory-to-amber hot puffs cooling to slate, short porous tail. Explosion: ivory ignition into coral/orange rounded lobes, separated like petals with dark gaps, a handful of short amber sparks and small charcoal chips, slate smoke pulled into separate diminishing puffs. Bold but disciplined. Prioritize small readable warm effects distinct from cool city neon.

Original supplementary comparison board for 3 smooth stylized 3D WEAPON EFFECTS directions: A COMPACT COMBUSTION, B NEON ION, C ARCADE POP. One landscape board with exactly THREE equal panels placed side by side. Each image panel itself MUST be 16:10 aspect ratio, not a wide cropped panorama. Thin dark border and short ivory option title above each. Clearly label bottom "GENERATED CAMERA STUDIES — NOT ENGINE CAPTURES". No technical numbers or fake measurements printed.
CRITICAL CAMERA: all three panels use identical street geometry and identical vertically downward perspective from 47 metres height, 42 degree vertical FOV, north-up, with 58m east-west and 36m north-south ground coverage implied. View ONLY roofs and tops of actors and vehicles, strictly no tilted camera, no cinematic/isometric camera. At image centre is an ordinary perpendicular street intersection with lane marks and crosswalks, rooftops in all four corners, 4m cars approximately 1/14 of image width, small 1.8m pedestrians. DARK VIBRANT CYBERPUNK city: ordinary architecture, smooth chunky stylized models, navy asphalt, cyan and magenta practical lights, warm windows. No logos, no names, no text inside world.
In same positions in ALL panels: lower-left small pedestrian fires north with a compact directional muzzle flash; upper-left one tiny amber/cyan/yellow surface hit; upper-right a small neutral charcoal rocket flies north with a SHORT porous trail behind; lower-right one compact explosion, size about a car length, separated fire lobes, generous visible street gaps. Effects must be recognisable at modest game scale, no large fog blanket, no ring suggesting blast damage radius.
A: ivory/amber tapered muzzle flash; small amber sparks/slate impact puff; short warm ivory/amber knots cooling to slate puffs; coral/orange rounded separated explosion petals, amber sparks, dark small chips, sparse broken slate smoke.
B: compact cyan-white forked muzzle with coral edge; tiny cyan impact with three broken coral arcs; short cyan hot knots cooling to violet/slate; cyan-white explosion core, separated coral/violet petals and few cyan sparks, sparse slate smoke. No magic full rings, no laser.
C: chunky butter-yellow three-lobed muzzle pop; small yellow-orange petal impact; short unequal orange droplet chain; orange scalloped rounded explosion, butter-yellow core, tiny hot-pink tips, few charcoal chips, sparse broken smoke. Bouncy smooth claylike forms, no BOOM words or comic stickers.
The purpose is fair comparison of distant overhead silhouettes; keep geometry, placement, environment illumination, object scale identical. All three images must retain real 16:10 shape. Attractive polished smooth 3D concept art, restrained glow.
